title: Requeue / outcome metrics taxonomy — append-only stats, reason-tagged breakdown keys, derived not-Completed umbrella, distinct-retried-jobs, warp.job.requeued meter, willRetry fix

public_contracts.name: Warp.Core.Enums.OutcomeReason { Retry = 1, RetryExhausted = 2, Concurrency = 3, RateLimit = 4, Timeout = 5, Saga = 6, Manual = 7, Recovery = 8 }
Meter: warp.job.requeued { queue, type, reason, application } — always-on, no key/PII tags

Statistic/Counter keys: stats:retried-jobs, stats:{requeued|failed|deleted}-{reason} (+ hourly buckets). NO stats:unsuccessful row — the not-Completed umbrella is derived on read as failed + deleted (CountersPage.buildRows), never stored
BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: stats:succeeded/failed/deleted are no longer decremented on requeue — they become append-only 'ever' counts (DecrementStatForState removed)

change_manifest_corrections: OutcomeStatKeys.cs was planned but reverted during T1 — an IEnumerable<Counter> return told the reader nothing at the call site. It shipped as the narrower Services/OutcomeReasonTokens.cs (enum -> token only); the Counter rows are spelled out at each site.

src/ui/tests/counters.spec.ts was never written. The UI check shipped instead as a LIVE Playwright suite (src/ui/e2e-live/outcome-stats.spec.ts + playwright.aspire.config.ts) driving the real Aspire stack, which is strictly stronger than the planned run against hand-written demo fixtures — those numbers could never have caught a metrics bug.

src/ui/src/demo/data.ts and CLAUDE.md are UNCHANGED — the demo fixtures are only read by the screenshot config, and CLAUDE.md's standards table indexes rule FILES (project-specific.md -> §8.x), not individual sections, so there is no per-section row to add. .claude/rules/project-specific.md DID change: §8.33 records the taxonomy.

src/tests/Warp.Tests/Reliability/CrashRecoveryTests.cs and src/tests/Warp.Tests/Features/Retry/RetryTests.cs are UNCHANGED. RSC3 landed in RequeueStatsTestsBase instead (RecoverStaleJobs cases); RSC8's retry-exhausted regression is covered by the pre-existing RetryTests and TimeoutIntegrationTests running green unmodified, which is the regression signal the batch wanted.

Publisher.cs + PublisherTests.cs are an out-of-scope DefaultQueue fix found during implementation (see the plan's progress notes); RetentionTests/RetentionEdgeCaseTests were collateral of the R3 decrement removal; the demo files added the seeds the live Playwright suite drives.

StatSurfaceTestsBase.cs was written last (RSC11), after the rest of the batch. It drives direct-drive WarpWorkerService iterations rather than a booted WarpTestServer: a concurrency-Wait outcome returns the job to Enqueued with ScheduleTime = now, so a polling worker re-requeues it for as long as the slot is held and the count stops being a constant — and RSC11 is an exactness claim. It needed one new test handler (TestData/Handlers/FailFirstAttemptCommand.cs) for the retry-recovers shape, which no existing handler produced.

REVISED during review. The not-Completed umbrella is DERIVED on read as failed + deleted and is never stored: no stats:unsuccessful Counter row is written anywhere, and CountersPage.buildRows computes it. The original 'stored umbrella equals failed + deleted' criterion was unmeetable — the umbrella was written at only the 2 worker finalization sites while failed/deleted also move at 6 others (DeleteJob, BulkDelete, both recovery arms, both worker cancellation paths), so the stored row under-reported from the first delete and the UI rendered a child exceeding its parent. Deriving a pure function of two stored values removes the drift by construction.
